title: Plans, invitations, offers
intro: Making plans is everyday English, at work and with friends. Choose the right future form, invite people warmly, offer help, and accept, decline or change arrangements without sounding cold.
introBn: পরিকল্পনা জানানো, আমন্ত্রণ দেওয়া, সাহায্যের প্রস্তাব দেওয়া, আর ভদ্রভাবে রাজি হওয়া, না বলা বা সময় বদলানোর ইংরেজি শিখুন।

units.title: Plans and arrangements
units.idea: Use the present continuous for fixed arrangements, going to for intentions, and will for quick decisions and offers made while speaking.
units.ideaBn: নির্দিষ্ট সময়-স্থান ঠিক থাকলে present continuous, পরিকল্পনা বা ইচ্ছা হলে going to, আর তাৎক্ষণিক সিদ্ধান্তে will।

formula.name: Arrangement
formula.pos: I'm meeting the client at 3 tomorrow.

formula.name: Intention
formula.pos: I'm going to look for a flat in Mirpur.

formula.name: Instant decision
formula.pos: It's raining. I'll take a CNG.

uses.rule: Present continuous: arranged with time, place or people.
uses.bn: সময়/জায়গা ঠিক হয়ে গেলে present continuous।
uses.ex: We're having lunch with the auditors on Monday.

uses.rule: Going to: a plan or intention you already have.
uses.bn: আগে থেকে ঠিক করা ইচ্ছা হলে going to।
uses.ex: Rafi is going to save money for a motorbike.

uses.rule: Will: a decision made at the moment of speaking.
uses.bn: কথা বলার মুহূর্তে নেওয়া সিদ্ধান্তে will।
uses.ex: The printer's broken? I'll email it to you instead.

uses.rule: Changing plans: move, put off, bring forward, cancel.
uses.bn: পরিকল্পনা বদলাতে move, put off, bring forward।
uses.ex: Can we move the meeting to Thursday?

uses.rule: Don't use 'will' with time words after 'when' or 'if'.
uses.bn: when/if এর পরে will নয়, present tense।
uses.ex: I'll call you when I get to the office.

traps.wrong: I will go to Rajshahi tomorrow, I already bought the ticket.
traps.right: I'm going to Rajshahi tomorrow. I've already bought the ticket.
traps.why: A booked trip is an arrangement.
traps.bn: টিকিট কাটা হয়ে গেলে present continuous।

traps.wrong: I'll call you when I will reach.
traps.right: I'll call you when I get there.
traps.why: No will after when; reach needs an object.
traps.bn: when এর পরে present; reach এর পর জায়গা লাগে।

traps.why: 'Prepone' is not standard outside South Asia.

drills.q: You booked a meeting room for 10 am tomorrow.
drills.s: I ___ the design team at 10 tomorrow.

drills.q: A plan you decided last week.
drills.s: I'm ___ to start a Spanish course in January.

drills.q: Your colleague says the lift isn't working.
drills.s: Don't worry, I ___ take the stairs.

o: I'll text you when I will arrive.
I'll text you when I arrive.
I text you when I will arrive.
I'm texting you when I will arrive.
drills.a: I'll text you when I arrive.

drills.q: মিটিংটা কি এক দিন এগিয়ে আনা যায়?
o: Could we bring the meeting forward by a day?
Could we prepone the meeting one day?
Can we forward the meeting a day before?
Could we bring forward a day the meeting?
drills.a: Could we bring the meeting forward by a day?

drills.s: We've had to put ___ the presentation until next week.
Rafi ___ flying to Chattogram on Sunday morning.

drills.q: আমি বৃহস্পতিবার বিকেলে ডাক্তারের কাছে যাচ্ছি।
o: I'm seeing the doctor on Thursday afternoon.
I will see the doctor in Thursday afternoon.
I'm going to see doctor at Thursday afternoon.
drills.a: I'm seeing the doctor on Thursday afternoon.

units.title: Inviting, offering, replying
units.idea: Invite with Would you like to…? or Do you fancy…? Offer help with Shall I…? or Let me… Accept warmly, and decline with thanks, a reason and an alternative.
units.ideaBn: আমন্ত্রণে Would you like to…?, সাহায্যের প্রস্তাবে Shall I…? বা Let me…। না বললে ধন্যবাদ, কারণ আর বিকল্প দিন।

formula.name: Invite
formula.pos: Would you like to join us for dinner? · Do you fancy a coffee? · Are you free on Friday?

formula.name: Offer
formula.pos: Shall I book a table? · Let me get that for you. · Would you like me to call them?

formula.name: Reply
formula.pos: I'd love to. · That sounds great. · Thanks, but I'm afraid I can't make it.

uses.rule: Would you like + to + verb for invitations.
uses.bn: Would you like এর পরে to + verb।
uses.ex: Would you like to come to our office party?

uses.rule: Do you fancy + -ing or a noun (informal).
uses.ex: Do you fancy getting some fuchka after work?

uses.rule: Shall I…? offers to do something.
uses.bn: কিছু করে দেওয়ার প্রস্তাবে Shall I…?
uses.ex: Shall I send you the slides?

uses.rule: Would you like me to…? is a polite offer.
uses.bn: ভদ্র প্রস্তাব: Would you like me to…?
uses.ex: Would you like me to pick you up from the station?

uses.rule: Decline with thanks, a reason and maybe another time.
uses.bn: ধন্যবাদ, কারণ আর অন্য সময়ের প্রস্তাব দিন।
uses.ex: Thanks so much, but I'm working late. Maybe next week?

traps.wrong: Would you like coming to dinner?
traps.right: Would you like to come to dinner?
traps.bn: would like এর পরে to + verb।

traps.wrong: Sorry, I can't come. I am busy.
traps.right: Thanks for asking, but I'm afraid I can't make it. I've got a family event.

drills.s: Would you like ___ us for lunch?
___ I book the meeting room for you?

drills.q: Pick the warmest way to decline a friend's wedding invitation.
o: Thank you so much for inviting me. I'm afraid I'll be in Sylhet, but I'd love to celebrate with you when I'm back.
drills.a: Thank you so much for inviting me. I'm afraid I'll be in Sylhet, but I'd love to celebrate with you when I'm back.

drills.s: Do you fancy ___ a film on Friday?

drills.q: আমি কি আপনাকে স্টেশন থেকে নিয়ে আসব?
o: Would you like me to pick you up from the station?
Would you like I pick you up from the station?
Shall I to pick you from station?
Do you want that I bring you from station?
drills.a: Would you like me to pick you up from the station?

drills.s: "Would you like to come to my house on Eid?" "___"
Put your wallet away. ___ me get this.

drills.q: Pick the best way to change an arrangement with a client.
o: I can't come tomorrow. Change it.
Something came up, so meeting is cancel.
I'm so sorry, but something urgent has come up. Would it be possible to reschedule for Thursday?
drills.a: I'm so sorry, but something urgent has come up. Would it be possible to reschedule for Thursday?

drills.q: দুঃখিত, শনিবার আমি আসতে পারব না।
o: I'm afraid I can't make it on Saturday.
Sorry, I can't make Saturday come.
I'm afraid I'm not able to coming Saturday.
Sorry, Saturday I can't to come.
drills.a: I'm afraid I can't make it on Saturday.
drills.x: Make it = be able to attend.

mastery.s: I ___ my manager at 4 this afternoon.

o: Shall I to open the window?
Shall I will open the window?

mastery.s: Would you like ___ for a quick coffee?

mastery.q: ক্লায়েন্টের জন্য মিটিংটা আগামী সপ্তাহে পিছিয়ে দিতে হয়েছে।
o: We've had to put off the meeting until next week because of the client.
We had to prepone the meeting next week for the client.
We have put the meeting back to next week for client.
We had to put on the meeting next week because of client.
mastery.a: We've had to put off the meeting until next week because of the client.

mastery.s: I'll send the file as soon as I ___ back.

mastery.q: Pick the most natural reply to an invitation you can't accept.
o: I'm afraid I can't make it, but thanks so much for asking.
mastery.a: I'm afraid I can't make it, but thanks so much for asking.
